newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom 96 net profit 1.6 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom 96 net profit 1.6 bln DM.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG said on Tuesday 1996 parent company net profit was 1.6 billion marks ($938.9 million), securing the company's planned dividend payment.

"Group net profit will be higher than this," chief executive Ron Sommer said at a news conference. "But there will be more details on this at the annual press conference. It is certain today that the dividend payment of 60 pfennig per share is assured."
Parent company net profit in 1995 was 1.3 billion marks. Sommer said parent company operating profit was more than six billion marks in 1996, an increase from four billion marks in 1995.
Group turnover in 1996 totaled 63.1 billion marks, an increase of six percent.
